name: the lead's bookings: what merging packages adds or saves together on the chapters route, S0's rows that a package's slice needed, and what a retirement saves (rulings K6, N1, O1, O2, U2, V3)
measuredWith: client-bundle.mjs bundleClient, as node build.mjs builds the client (dist/client-size-report.json: routes.chapters.code)
whatWasMeasured: Nothing of its own: this file books no package's bytes (ownBytes 0). Each item of sharedPoolBytes is a measured change of the chapters route that is no package's own, recorded under items with the builds it was measured on. Only this file may book a negative item (ruling O1), for what merging packages saves together (ruling N1: stub bytes are not additive) and for what a retirement saves (ruling U2). The lead's merge check (rc44-s0-readings.mjs assertBookingsAddUp, S0's suite block 'O1 the bookings add up') holds that on a build the chapters route less the integrated base is every size file's own bytes plus the shared pool's, exactly. Joined at the merge of rc44/integration (c709ae3) into the third fix-up of wp2 slice 5 (ruling V3): the item of wp9a's branch (trackPathsPartNameO2, 0 B) and the item of wp2 slice 5's second fix-up (guidedConcernRetirementQ8, -3,047 B), each kept as it was measured.

allowance.of: the lead's own file books no bytes of its own; its items are the shared pool's (rulings F1 and H1: 1,656 B for the seven later packages, of which wp9a's evidence books 98 B). Of the retirement's saving booked below, 400 B are wp2's allowance (ruling U2: wp2 1,200 B = 600 B by A4 + 200 B by Q10 + 400 B of the saving), and the rest, 2,647 B, joins the shared pool (ruling U2)

trackPathsPartNameO2.ruling: O2 (wp9a slice 1, third fix-up): S0's row trackPaths, the part's name in design-extension-parts.js with its start check
trackPathsPartNameO2.measuredOn: the third fix-up of wp9a slice 1 after its item 2, against its start 5cae40a, each with node build.mjs (dist/client-size-report.json routes.chapters.code): 3,230,605 B before and after
trackPathsPartNameO2.why: design-extension-parts.js is in no client bundle (S0's block 8 asserts it), and the boundary's copy of the trackPaths, stampTracked and settle are server-only: the route did not move. Booked at 0 so that the row is on the books.

guidedConcernRetirementQ8.ruling: U2 (wp2 slice 5, second fix-up): the saving of Q8's retirement of row 9, the guided comparison of a released concern (its start, answers, preparation, re-reading and preview, the comparison's builder on the route, the comparison tools' released-concern picker)
guidedConcernRetirementQ8.measuredOn: the second fix-up of wp2 slice 5 at 9df762c (after its items U1, U4, U3 and U5), each with node build.mjs (dist/client-size-report.json routes.chapters.code): the tree as it is, 3,228,422 B; the same tree (a git archive of 9df762c) with public/architecture-design.js and public/architecture-task-ui.js as at 082e06b (the slice before the retirement; no later commit touched them but the retirement's 4334100 and 452604e), 3,231,469 B
guidedConcernRetirementQ8.why: Retiring an old path is what the doctrine asks; its saving is not a package's own figure (ruling U2). The saving is the route with the guided path's code put back less the route without it: 3,231,469 - 3,228,422 = 3,047 B. wp2 S5 books its gross additions, measured with the retirement put back (3,231,469 - 3,230,605 = 864 B, wp2-s5-size.json ownBytes).

mergeAuthorY3.ruling: Y3 (slice S0-D12, the lead's, wave 2; with D12 and H3) and its fix-up under rulings Z1 to Z7: who wrote what workspace.merge writes. The alternative keeps who prepared each command (public/workbench-domain.js applyWorkbenchCommand, workspace.alternative and workspace.revise-alternative), the merge applies each command as its preparer and hands the server each command's result (merged), the server stamps it (public/provenance.js mergeStamper, worker.js), the boundary counts a merge's review and refuses the preparer and the merger as the second person and removes a staged handler's author fields (design-extension-boundary.js); the obligation verifier refuses the merger while the merge's stamp stands (public/architecture-obligations.js verifierRefusal, ruling Z1)
mergeAuthorY3.measuredOn: rc44/s0-d12-merge-author against its start 53ce4cf (rc44/integration): 3,228,648 B before and after (e91365c). Its fix-up (rc44/s0-d12-merge-author-fix, from e91365c), each with node build.mjs (dist/client-size-report.json routes.chapters.code): 3,228,648 B at e91365c; 3,228,746 B after Z1 (+98 B, verifierRefusal's reading of the merge's stamp); 148 script files and the buckets (52, 51, 45) unchanged
mergeAuthorY3.why: applyWorkbenchCommand is in no client bundle (the browser previews with previewWorkingChange and previewScenarioAlternative and sends the command; the server applies it), mergeStamper and settle are server-only (tree-shaken: no client chunk holds them), and the boundary and worker.js are the server's. The route moves by what the client's own readers gain: verifierRefusal (public/architecture-obligations.js, on the route) reads author.mergedBy and reviewed.mergedBy (+98 B, ruling Z1: the route bytes of the verifier's reading are S0's, booked to the pool).
